class: A Playwright spec that replaces a server route or socket with a hand-written stand-in keeps the server's OLD behaviour when the server changes (a new protocol field, an edit the route now applies); the page, written against the new server, then never reaches the state the spec waits for, and the only catch is the Playwright CI job after the push.
mechanism: Two runs since 2026-10-24. (1) Run 40083846807 (build/seq-chunk-2 7f86296): 20cdbbc1 made the page drop a strategy-socket push whose seq is not the version it sent; the two socket fakes in feed-reconnect.spec.ts and execute-screen.spec.ts sent no seq, so data-live stayed 'connecting' ('no Execute action: phase=waiting-live'). Fixed by 5c35b41f (shared helper frontend/e2e/support/echoSeq.ts). (2) Run 40045667454 (43edf26): the leg-edit stand-in in leg-rows.spec.ts copied each leg's old 'included' instead of applying the include edit as the real route does, so 'Left out of the numbers' never showed. Fixed by b6e9421b.

first_seen.evidence: gh run view <id> --log-failed read on this PC 2026-10-26: leg-rows.spec.ts:45 toHaveText('Left out of the numbers') element not found (4 failures incl. retry #1); feed-reconnect.spec.ts:44 data-live expected 'live' received 'connecting' (incl. retry #1). Neither is timing-dependent.

fix: Instances fixed (5c35b41f, b6e9421b). Class fix open for owner decision (owner-questions-2026-10-26.md Q4): running the Playwright specs that stand in for a changed route or socket before the push is a local app check, which ADR-189 removed. Until then: a brief that changes a route reply or a socket message greps frontend/e2e for stand-ins of that route (routeWebSocket, page.route) and updates them (kit builder-brief standing item 'a change to a shown value greps every test tree, end-to-end included').

detection.note: Caught only by the Playwright CI job (one red run, ~9 min median, plus a fix round each). Specs still using routeWebSocket without echoSeq on main 2026-10-26: chain-selection, home, index-view, live-strategies, strategy-live (not checked whether each fakes the strategy socket).
